why: The Escape that closed a pane keeps propagating to the page's bubble-phase listener, which forwards it to the session's pause hotkey: Escape on Controllers over Pause closes the panel AND resumes the round underneath it in the same keystroke. hud.navigation.test.ts (244): both Escape cases, each asserting the bubble-phase listener saw nothing for the Escape that closed a pane. Pinned by name since the hud suite was split (issue #511); its killers live in hud.navigation.test.ts.
killedBy: hud: Escape is Back while a layer is open (issue #318) Escape closes the top pane, restores the opener, and never reaches a bubble-phase window listener; with no pane it reaches it and changes no surface
hud: Escape is Back while a layer is open (issue #318) Escape with Controllers open over Pause returns to Pause and fires onControllersClose exactly once; a second Escape is not consumed
